description: Generate a multi-room layout inside the wired Space — set each room's Min/Max area + max aspect Ratio. Draggable seeds + connection/repulsion lines on the canvas; each room's Area/Ratio is colour-coded green (ok) / red (violated). Run Annealing to optimise.
instructions:
A front-end to the interactive floorplan generator. Wire a Space (boundary) into the input, set the rooms / algorithm / connections / repulsions, then press Generate — the host runs the generator and loads it as the canvas's editable layout (draggable seeds, connection/repulsion lines, Add Room all work on the canvas). Run Annealing optimises the seed positions.

The `rooms` list (label + min/max area + max aspect ratio) is edited by the on-node rooms editor; the canvas colour-codes each generated room's Area / Ratio against it (green ok / red violated). `algorithm` = BSP (recursive split) or RDG (room graph). Room count / floor area / SA score are published for an Output node.
